# POS API Reference

## Docs
- [Introduction](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/introduction-1597404m0.md): 

## API Docs
- Checks [List checks](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/list-checks-21341400e0.md): Retrieve a paginated list of checks
- Checks [Get check by ID](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/get-check-by-id-21341401e0.md): Retrieve a specific check by its ID
- Checks [Create a new check](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/create-a-new-check-21341402e0.md): Create a new check
- Checks [Add items to check](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/add-items-to-check-21341403e0.md): Add menu items to an existing check
- Checks [Add payment to check](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/add-payment-to-check-21341404e0.md): Add a payment to an existing check
- Checks [Add discount to check](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/add-discount-to-check-21341405e0.md): Add a discount to an existing check
- Customers [List customers](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/list-customers-21341406e0.md): Retrieve a paginated list of customers
- Customers [Create customer](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/create-customer-21341407e0.md): Create a new customer
- Customers [Update customer](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/update-customer-21341408e0.md): Update an existing customer
- Menu Items [List menu items (v2)](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/list-menu-items-v2-21341409e0.md): Retrieve a paginated list of menu items using v2 API
- Menu Items [Get menu item by ID](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/get-menu-item-by-id-21341410e0.md): Retrieve a specific menu item by its ID
- Menu Items [Create menu item](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/create-menu-item-21341411e0.md): Create a new menu item
- Menu Items [Update menu item](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/update-menu-item-21341412e0.md): Update an existing menu item
- Employees [List employees](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/list-employees-21341413e0.md): Retrieve a paginated list of employees
- Properties [List properties](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/list-properties-21341414e0.md): Retrieve a list of properties
- Reports [Get daily totals (v2)](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/get-daily-totals-v2-21341415e0.md): Retrieve daily totals using v2 API
- Accounting [List enterprises](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/list-enterprises-21341416e0.md): Retrieve a list of enterprises
- Accounting [Get enterprise by ID](https://developers.simprasuite.com/simpra-pos/get-enterprise-by-id-21341417e0.md): Retrieve a specific enterprise by its ID
